  the S-9 replay variant that omits every numeric the delivered record does not hold and names
  them in notRecorded (spec §8.2); one run per reviewed round, phases inferred iff the artifact
  exists, approvals only from _rules/facts.json else "not_recorded".
- DemoDossierDto/DemoTimelineDto/DemoRunReportDto/FigureImageCardDto/DemoCardFactsDto and
  DemoMarkersDto.notRecorded/assetRefs — additive to @rhema/api-client.
- project/replay.ts: inferRuns, replayedDossier/replayedRunReport, demoTimeline, figureImages,
  demoCardFacts (sole card-count owner — 213's composeDeliveredSummary/deliveredRecordCounts and
  statusMeters called, never re-implemented) + registerRunKinds.
- Committed synthetic snapshots regenerated additively; drafts gain demo.assetRefs (REQ-DWEB-17
  route shape); dossier snapshot checked against DossierViewData by colocated apps/web test.
- ADR-126 dated note records the owned decisions; COVERAGE.md + run ledger + PR body.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Steve Vitali
Message:
R7COPY.0 — retire the generated walkthrough; record-composed run card; one run state, one count

REQ-COPY-4: 'What it delivered' is composed deterministically from the delivered
record — the letter's verdict line quoted verbatim (one_thing/Verdict slot, none
shown when absent, never paraphrased), the one-rule finding/claim counts, and the
dossier/letter/ledger links. composeDeliveredSummary + deliveredRecordCounts +
parseLetterSections/SLOT_PATTERNS in findings-core (pure; 218a can replay them).

The run.walkthrough model call path is removed end-to-end (ADR-130): orchestrator
walkthrough.ts, worker walkthrough-generator.ts, RUN_JOBS.walkthrough, the
handler/consumer/env slot, the api lazy enqueue + retry route, the web retry
POST + data/api-client call, and RunCard's walkthrough block + retry_walkthrough.
runs.walkthrough stays, unread; the artifact kind stays. Queued jobs expire under
pg-boss (recorded in the ADR). The worker's ingest key decouples from
WALKTHROUGH_MODEL_KEY_SECRET — kept only as the legacy fallback name so every
deployed stage resolves identically (env.test.ts pins it).

REQ-SYNC-1: one RunSummaryView — the dossier mounts the same SQL-fact card the
Timeline builds (deriveRunCardInput + its run_events read are gone; the cards
are asserted identical). REQ-SYNC-2: one count rule — deliveredRecordCounts feeds
the Timeline chips, the dossier card, and the margin stack chip; strengths ride
their own figure (C5). run-state-parity.dom asserts identical state/credits/
phase marks on the Timeline card, the dossier card, and the status bar.

ADR-130 filled (decision + COGS −1 call/run, no money-mode change, pg-boss
expiry, infra residue, golden classification = NOT protocol-affecting). Dated
banners on REQ-IDE-19 + DS §5.6 D20. D-R7COPY.0-1/-2 opened; D-RUN.1-2 dated note.
